title: Two Impossible Babies
paragraphs: A lot of people have already tried to put together the story of everything God did among us, using the reports handed down by the original eyewitnesses — the people who gave their whole lives to serving this message. Since I carefully investigated everything from the very beginning, I decided to write it all out for you, most honorable Theophilus, in an orderly way, so you can know beyond any doubt that what you were taught is totally reliable.
§A Childless Couple Conceives

Back when Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, assigned to the Abijah division. His wife Elizabeth came from a priestly family — she was a descendant of Aaron. They were good, rule-following people living honorably before God. But they had a massive heartbreak in their lives: they couldn't have kids, and now they were practically senior citizens.

One day, it was Zechariah's big once-in-a-lifetime turn to go inside the main Temple sanctuary and burn incense. The crowd was outside praying. Suddenly, an angel of the Lord appeared, standing right next to the altar. Zechariah froze, absolutely terrified.

But the angel reassured him: "Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God heard your prayer. Your wife Elizabeth is going to have a son, and you are going to name him John. He is going to bring you massive joy, and not just you — tons of people will celebrate his birth. He will be great in God's eyes."

"He'll drink neither wine nor beer, and he'll be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he's born. He's going to turn many of the people of Israel back to their God. He'll come in the style and strength of Elijah — softening the hearts of parents toward their children and waking up hardened skeptics — getting everyone ready for the Lord."
Zechariah looked at him and essentially said, "Yeah right. Prove it. I'm an old man, and my wife is old too. How can I be sure this is real?"

The angel was not amused. "I am Gabriel. I stand in the actual presence of God, and He personally sent me to give you this good news. But because you didn't believe my words, you are going to be completely mute. You won't be able to speak a single syllable until the day this baby is born. Every word I just told you will come true right on time — God's time."

Meanwhile the crowd outside was getting restless, wondering what was taking him so long in the sanctuary. When Zechariah finally came out, he couldn't talk — he just kept making hand gestures, and everyone realized he had seen a vision.

When Zechariah's Temple assignment was over, he went back home. It wasn't long before his wife Elizabeth got pregnant. She stayed hidden away for five months, soaking in the joy. "So this is how God takes away my disgrace!" she said.
§A Virgin Conceives

Six months into Elizabeth's pregnancy, God sent Gabriel on another mission, this time to a village called Nazareth in Galilee. He appeared to a virgin named Mary, who was engaged to Joseph, a descendant of David. Gabriel walked in and greeted her: "Greetings! You are highly favored, and the Lord is with you."

Mary was super confused and honestly a little freaked out, wondering what kind of greeting this was. But Gabriel assured her: "Don't be afraid, Mary. God has chosen to bless you. You are going to get pregnant and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus. He will be incredibly great and will be called the Son of the Most High. God will give him the throne of his ancestor David. He will rule over Jacob's family forever, and his kingdom will never, ever end."
Mary asked the obvious question: "How is that even possible? I'm a virgin."
Gabriel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come over you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. The baby will be holy — the Son of God."

"And did you know that your cousin Elizabeth conceived a son, old as she is? Everyone called her barren, and here she is six months pregnant! Nothing, you see, is impossible with God." Mary bravely took a deep breath and said, "I am the Lord's servant. Let it happen exactly like you said." And the angel left.
§Blessed Among Women

Mary didn't waste a minute. She got up and traveled to a town in the hill country of Judah, straight to Zechariah's house, and greeted Elizabeth. The absolute second Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby inside her leaped for joy. Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit and sang out: "You're so blessed among women, and the baby in your womb is blessed too! Why am I so honored that the mother of my Lord visits me? The moment I heard your greeting, the baby in my womb jumped for sheer joy. Blessed woman, who believed what God said — believed every word would come true!"

Then Mary sang out: "I'm bursting with God-news — I'm dancing the song of my Savior God! God took one good look at little old me, and look what happened — I'm the most fortunate woman on earth! What God has done for me will never be forgotten. His very name is holy, set apart from all others. His mercy keeps flowing in wave after wave to everyone who stands in awe of him. He flexed his arm and showed his strength, scattering the arrogant braggarts. He knocked tyrants off their high horses and pulled victims out of the mud. The starving poor got a full banquet; the cold-hearted rich got left out in the cold. He took his chosen child Israel in his arms, remembering his promise — he piled on the mercy, piled it high. It's exactly what he promised, starting with Abraham and continuing right up to now."
Mary stayed with Elizabeth for three months and then went back home.
§The Birth of John
When it was time for Elizabeth's baby to be born, all the neighbors and relatives showed up to celebrate, seeing how God had overwhelmed her with mercy.
On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child and were about to name him Zechariah after his dad. But Elizabeth stepped in: "No. His name is John."
They argued with her. "Nobody in your family has that name!" Then they used sign language to ask Zechariah what he wanted the boy named.

He asked for a writing tablet and wrote: "His name is John." Everyone was stunned — and then came surprise number two: Zechariah's mouth opened, his tongue was loose, and he was talking, praising God!

A deep, reverent fear settled over the whole neighborhood, and all through the Judean hill country people talked about nothing else. Everyone who heard it took it to heart, wondering, "What will become of this child? Clearly, God has his hand on him."

Then Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied: "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel — he came and set his people free. He set the power of salvation right in the center of our lives, in the very house of David his servant, just as he promised long ago through his holy prophets: rescue from our enemies and every hateful hand; mercy to our fathers, remembering what he swore to our father Abraham — a clean rescue from the enemy camp, so we can worship him without a care in the world, made holy before him as long as we live. And you, my child — 'Prophet of the Highest' — will go ahead of the Master to prepare his ways, bringing his people the offer of salvation, the forgiveness of their sins. Through the heartfelt mercies of our God, God's Sunrise will break in upon us, shining on those in the darkness, those sitting in the shadow of death, showing us the way, one foot at a time, down the path of peace."
The child grew up strong and healthy, full of spirit. He lived out in the desert until the day came for him to step onto the scene in Israel as God's prophet.

EN 5~6번 문단(배지 '13-15'/'15-17'): MSG 문단 구분에 맞춰 천사 말 2개 문단으로 분리. '포도주·독주를 입에 대지 않음', '엘리야의 스타일과 능력', '부모 마음을 자녀에게로' 복원. 기존 'But the angel said to him:' 단편 문단 삭제

EN 15~16번 문단(배지 '35'/'36-38'): MSG 문단 구분에 맞춤. '사촌 엘리사벳' 복원
